content.guideline: 2024 Perioperative Cardiovascular Management for Noncardiac Surgery
key_points: Intraoperative management is associated with various clinical outcomes for noncardiac surgery.
Perioperative hypotension in noncardiac surgery is a significant concern, with various studies analyzing its impact.
Use of continuous noninvasive blood pressure monitoring is explored for high-risk surgeries.
Heart failure management in the perioperative setting is also discussed.
